items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I saw Basie opposite Gerry Mulligan’s – whatever it was called – the jazz concert band.

ctx.x: I never knew this record. It had – because it said it’s his only engagement in New York during those years. It said something in the liner notes. This is just a few days ago, for a Christmas party. I said to the guy, that has to have been the week I was there, because I saw Basie opposite Gerry Mulligan’s – whatever it was called – the jazz concert band.
